annotations.text: G — Arc gauge. A radial progress ring carries the position; the 4 parts sit beneath with counts. Trade-off: the ring costs vertical space that the flat index (H) spends on labels.
H — Numbered index. No ring at all: 01–18 as a numbered index with part rules. Trade-off: reads as a table of contents, so it loses the at-a-glance sense of progress the gauge gives.

I — Dot matrix. All 18 sections as one 6×3 map, only the active section labelled. Shortest of the three (471–527px). Trade-off: 17 of 18 dots are unlabelled, so it only works for someone already oriented.
